description: Returns intact or broken_at for a supplied signed export; use it to check a gate_audit_proof export rather than retrieve audit rows. Recomputes the chain and project signature; broken_at is a one-based row position. Does not approve actions or change permissions.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

proof.description: The full signed export from gate_audit_proof

name: gate_audit_verify
title: Verify a signed audit export
